clue.text: Sort of humour we get from student in Glasgow, initially 'off', perhaps?

indicators.note: in tells us the student's letter goes inside the trimmed city name
perhaps hints that the letters given might be arranged some other way, signalling a rearrangement
the city's initial letter is taken off, so its first letter is dropped

parts.note: L is the learner-driver plate, standing for a student or learner

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a Glasgow student's dark sense of humour is a bit off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially off' removes the G of GLASGOW, leaving LASGOW; 'in' puts L inside it, and 'perhaps' rearranges the seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallows humour is grim joking about death or disaster, named after the hangman's scaffold.

clue.text: Make sound like turkey or swallow

explanation.definitionFit: A turkey's call is a throaty gurgle; to wolf food down is to eat greedily.

clue.text: Cantonese fodder crop

parts.note: Cantonese means from a Swiss canton, not from Canton in China: a forage plant sharing its name with one of those cantons

explanation.definitionFit: Lucerne is another name for alfalfa, a forage plant, and also a Swiss canton.

clue.text: Exception taken by old theologian, chap adjudged lbw?

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a theologian
a man is a chap
a batsman given leg before wicket in cricket is out

explanation.surface: An elderly theologian playing cricket is given out leg before, an unusual case.
explanation.walkthrough: LBW (leg before wicket) is a way a batsman is dismissed in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: The one who differs from the rest of a group is the exception.

clue.text: Like the best candidates, inclined to have spirit, for a start

indicators.note: for a start puts the spirit word at the front of the inclined word

parts.note: a short is a small measure of spirits
listed means tilted or leaning, as a ship lists

explanation.surface: The top applicants tend to need a drink first.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'short' is British for a small glass of spirits such as whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Applicants picked out from the rest for final consideration are on the select list.

clue.text: Graduate just after appearing in commercial having to hide

indicators.note: appearing in places the following letters within the advertisement word

parts.note: AD is short for advertisement, a commercial
BSc, Bachelor of Science, is a graduate
on can mean immediately after, as in 'on arrival'

explanation.surface: A graduate turns up in an advert just after being made to go into hiding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appearing in' is the container signal; 'just after' gives ON in the sense of 'on arrival', meaning immediately after.
explanation.definitionFit: To abscond is to run off secretly and lie low, which is to hide from the law.

clue.text: Person of little wisdom joining a dictator's bodyguard

parts.note: the SS was Hitler's bodyguard corps

explanation.surface: A foolish person signs up to guard a tyrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool or idiot is a person without much sense.

clue.text: Rail fare?

explanation.definitionFit: To rail is to jeer or mock; fare is food, which slang calls grub.

clue.text: Managed to hold up deliveries, having gone on too long

indicators.note: in a down entry the managed word sits beneath and so holds up the deliveries word

parts.note: an over is a set of six deliveries in cricket
to run something is to manage it

explanation.surface: Someone managed to delay the bowling, and the match ran late.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is six balls bowled in a row.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting that has exceeded its allotted time has run past its limit.

clue.text: Debate is confused, in disorder

indicators.note: confused signals that the letters of Debate is are jumbled

explanation.surface: A debate gets muddled and descends into chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabetes is a medical condition, a disorder of blood sugar regulation.

clue.text: Defender lets go of painted curtains

parts.note: a back is a defending player in football or hockey
drops means lets go of, releases

explanation.surface: A footballer lets go of some curtains he has painted.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre backdrops are large painted cloths hung at the rear of a stage.

clue.text: Time to sit by old piano for musical piece

indicators.note: to sit by places the time word right beside the old piano letters

parts.note: P is the musical marking for piano, softly
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: It is time to sit down at an old piano and play some music.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a dramatic work set to music, a musical piece for the stage.

clue.text: Cellar vault serves grub

indicators.note: serves suggests the phrase supplies the answer from inside itself, so look within Cellar vault

explanation.surface: A vaulted wine cellar is where food is served.
explanation.definitionFit: A grub is the soft young stage of an insect, its immature form.

clue.text: Time to request church to establish working party

parts.note: to ask for is to request
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: It's time to ask the church to set up a working group.
explanation.definitionFit: A task force is a group set up for a particular job, a working party.

clue.text: Means whereby we lose moisture, it transpires

definitions.text: Means whereby we lose moisture, it transpires

parts.words: Means whereby we lose moisture, it transpires
parts.note: transpires reads as 'it turns out' but also as giving off moisture through the skin

explanation.definitionFit: These skin organs secrete perspiration, the body's way of shedding water.

clue.text: Not really fair?

parts.note: fair here means light-haired: someone whose fairness comes out of a bottle of bleach

explanation.definitionFit: Hair bleached with hydrogen peroxide is fair only artificially, not naturally.

clue.text: Double trouble ultimately after Indian goddess cracks face

indicators.note: after places the final letter of trouble behind the rest
the goddess cracks open the face word and sits inside it

parts.note: look can mean face or expression
Kali is the Hindu goddess of destruction

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter of trouble

explanation.surface: A Hindu goddess breaks into a smile, and a twin causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A double is someone who closely resembles another person.

clue.text: Authenticate account given by radical Italian

parts.note: red is used for a political radical

explanation.surface: A left-wing Italian vouches for an account.
explanation.definitionFit: To accredit is to certify officially as genuine or approved.

clue.text: Walk on the right side of the law?

definitions.text: on the right side of the law?

explanation.definitionFit: A health walk taken for exercise; also lawful under a nation's founding charter.

clue.text: Cancel most of flying exercises around mid- July

indicators.note: around has the rearranged letters wrapped round the middle of July
exercises suggests the letters are worked over and put into a new order
most of drops the last letter of flying
mid- points to the central letters of the month

explanation.surface: Flying displays are called off in the middle of July.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying exercises' reads as an air display, but 'exercises' rearranges what is left of the first word, and 'around' wraps it about the centre of the month.
explanation.definitionFit: To nullify is to void or annul something.

clue.text: Expert made to look

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Expert made to look', is cut short: ACE (expert) round an anagram of MADE fits ACADEME, but no definition or anagram indicator survives

clue.text: Woman's accepting eastern philosophy finally, an unorthodox belief

indicators.note: accepting has the woman's word take in the eastern letter

parts.note: hers means belonging to a woman

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of philosophy

explanation.surface: A woman takes up an eastern philosophy, a belief outside the mainstream.
explanation.definitionFit: Heresy is opinion contrary to accepted doctrine.

clue.text: Function attended by mannequin — one who's looked up to

parts.note: a role is a function or part played
a mannequin is a fashion model

explanation.surface: A fashion model attends a function and is admired by everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: A person admired and imitated as an example is someone others look up to.

clue.text: Weaver losing head over content of track er?

indicators.note: over signals the remaining letters are turned the other way round
losing head removes the first letter

parts.note: Bottom is the weaver in Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream

explanation.surface: A weaver gets carried away over what's inside a Christmas novelty.
explanation.walkthrough: BOTTOM without its B is OTTOM, which 'over' reverses. British Christmas crackers hold a paper hat, a toy and a printed saying or joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A short saying printed on a slip is found inside a Christmas cracker.

clue.text: Blunt seaman partook of refreshment

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
ate means partook of food

explanation.surface: A plain-speaking sailor had a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: To blunt something is to dull or lessen it, the sense of diminishing force.

clue.text: He believes daughter is in Egypt

indicators.note: in places the word is inside the abbreviation for Egypt

parts.note: ET is the international vehicle code for Egypt

explanation.surface: A man's daughter is living in Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: One holding faith in a creator who does not intervene is a believer of a particular kind.

clue.text: Creepy-crawly thirty metres long?

explanation.definitionFit: A many-legged arthropod; its name means a hundred feet, roughly thirty metres.

clue.text: Fish offered in jest

explanation.definitionFit: A common food fish; also an adjective for mock or spoof, as in a pretend accent.

clue.text: Relaxing hydro — it's good for goitre

indicators.note: relaxing loosens the arrangement of the following letters so they can be reordered

parts.note: the 's is just 'is', so only IT gives letters

explanation.surface: A spell at a relaxing spa is said to help a swollen neck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relaxing' rearranges HYDRO and IT. The definition uses the old sense of the word as a medicine: dried gland extract given to treat goitre.
explanation.definitionFit: Extract of the gland in the neck was long prescribed as a remedy for an enlarged neck swelling.

clue.text: Flats adjacent to play area

explanation.definitionFit: Stage flats are painted panels of a set, which surrounds the acting area of a play.
